_howto: 这是全站唯一的内容文件。改完在本目录执行 `node build.js`，index.html（中文）和 en.html（英文）会同时重新生成。
所有 zh / en 字段都要成对填写。文本支持 **加粗**、*斜体*、[文字](链接) 三种轻量标记；写成 [[待补充：xxx]] 的内容会渲染成琥珀色虚线标记。
url 留空的侧栏链接不会出现在页面上（也不留灰色占位）；补齐 url 后重新构建即自动显示。
证件照原图在 assets/avatar.jpg；执行 node build.js 会自动把它转成纯文本 assets/avatar.svg（内嵌 base64），页面与 og:image 都引用该 SVG，便于纯文本通道发布。换照片只需替换 jpg 后重新构建。
badge 颜色 tone 可选：red（顶刊 / 一区 Top）、blue（主流期刊）、gray（中文 / 其他）、green（在投 / 会议）。
所有列表条目一律按时间倒序（最新在最前）：奖项 / 论文按年份，经历按起始年月，教育按学位时间线。
论文 metrics 字段：{"if": "18.1", "tier": {"zh": "中科院一区 Top", "en": "CAS Tier 1 (Top)"}}；media 为报道来源数组，mediaExtra 为报道补充说明。

title.zh: 个人简介
title.en: Biography

paragraphs.zh: 刘冠宇，**中国南方电力调度控制中心水电及新能源处主管**，北京大学物理学院大气与海洋科学系 **大气物理学与大气环境** 专业博士（保送直博，2026 届），导师李婧教授（国家杰出青年科学基金获得者）。2024–2025 年获 **CSC 国家公派留学** 资助赴德国莱比锡大学联合培养，师从 IPCC AR6 主要作者 Johannes Quaas 教授。研究聚焦 **自然源气溶胶与气候变率的相互作用**、**野火的天气与气候效应** 与 **机器学习大气遥感反演**。
paragraphs.en: Guanyu Liu is **Supervisor of the Hydropower and New Energy Division at the China Southern Power Grid (CSG) Power Dispatching and Control Center**, and holds a Ph.D. in **Atmospheric Physics and Atmospheric Environment** from the Department of Atmospheric and Oceanic Sciences, School of Physics, Peking University (2026; direct admission), advised by Prof. Jing Li (NSFC Distinguished Young Scholar). From 2024 to 2025 he was a **CSC-sponsored visiting doctoral researcher** at Leipzig University, Germany, working with Prof. Johannes Quaas, a lead author of IPCC AR6. His research centers on **interactions between natural aerosols and climate variability**, **the weather and climate effects of wildfires**, and **machine-learning retrievals for atmospheric remote sensing**.

paragraphs.zh: 已发表论文 **18 篇**，其中第一作者 **11 篇**（SCI 论文 10 篇），累计影响因子逾 **150**，成果见于 *Nature Communications*、*PNAS*、*Science Advances*、*Geophysical Research Letters*、*Science Bulletin* 等期刊。主持北京大学「碳与气候」博士研究生未名学者奖学金项目，并参与国家自然科学基金杰出青年基金、面上项目及科技部国家重点研发计划课题。
paragraphs.en: He has published **18 papers**, including **11 first-author papers** (10 in SCI journals), with a cumulative impact factor above **150**, appearing in *Nature Communications*, *PNAS*, *Science Advances*, *Geophysical Research Letters* and *Science Bulletin*. He led the Peking University Weiming Scholar Fellowship project on Carbon and Climate, and contributed to NSFC Distinguished Young Scholar and General Program grants and a National Key R&D Program project.

paragraphs.zh: 兼具 **大气科学 + 电力调度 + 遥感 AI + 保险金融** 的交叉背景。现任中国南方电力调度控制中心水电及新能源处主管，负责电力气象与新能源功率预测等业务，并开发气象数据分析工具与调度气象智能体应用；此前曾在中国长江三峡集团科学技术研究院、微软亚洲研究院（AI for Science）、北京佳格天地与中科院计算技术研究所实习，把数值模拟与机器学习带入真实业务场景，推动科研成果向能源调度、防灾减灾与气候服务转化。同时侧重「电力 + 气象」线上科普，累计观看人数逾 2 万；并担任北京大学博士生讲师团成员与「蔚蓝空间」学术讲座负责人。
paragraphs.en: His background bridges **atmospheric science, power system dispatching, remote-sensing AI and insurance/finance**. At CSG he is responsible for power meteorology and renewable-energy power forecasting, and develops meteorological data-analysis tools and dispatching-oriented AI agents. Earlier internships at the China Three Gorges Corporation Research Institute, Microsoft Research Asia (AI for Science), GAGO Inc. and the Institute of Computing Technology (CAS) shaped a practice of bringing numerical modelling and machine learning into operational settings and translating research into energy dispatch, disaster risk reduction and climate services. He also focuses on online science communication at the *power + meteorology* interface, reaching an audience of over 20,000, and serves as a member of the Peking University Ph.D. Lecturers Group and organiser of the *Blue Space* seminar series.

bullets.zh: 在调度处挂职学习一年，并赴各类型电厂、换流站、中调等调研，系统学习接线图、电力系统运行、调规操规、调频备用、直流原理与事故处理等电气知识，学习撰写操作票，使用 OCS、OMS、DCCS 等调度业务系统；负责早汇报、简报日报等日常材料制作
bullets.en: One-year secondment in the dispatching division, with field visits to various power plants, converter stations and regional dispatch centres; studied single-line diagrams, power system operations, dispatch regulations and operating rules, frequency regulation and reserves, HVDC principles and incident handling; learned to prepare switching operation tickets and worked with the OCS, OMS and DCCS dispatching systems; prepared morning briefs, daily bulletins and other routine reports

bullets.zh: 负责电力气象、新能源功率预测等业务，开发 MeteoStudio、MeteoWorkbench 气象数据分析工具，交付可用版本并配套用⁠户⁠文⁠档；构建电力气象报告专家智能体、调度气象参谋智能体等 AI 应用并落地实践，搭建天气预报网站与值班月览网站，支撑早汇报与材料编制
bullets.en: Responsible for power meteorology and renewable-energy power forecasting; developed the MeteoStudio and MeteoWorkbench meteorological data-analysis tools and delivered working releases with user documentation; built and deployed AI applications including a power-meteorology report expert agent and a dispatching meteorology advisory agent; built a weather forecast portal and a monthly duty overview site to support morning briefs and report preparation

title.zh: Middle East dust as an important external driver of the Indian Ocean Dipole
title.en: Middle East dust as an important external driver of the Indian Ocean Dipole

authors.zh: **G Liu**, S.-P Xie, J E Hansen, et al. · 17, 2166
authors.en: **G Liu**, S.-P Xie, J E Hansen, et al. · 17, 2166

note.zh: 揭示中东沙尘是印度洋偶极子（IOD）的重要外部驱动：沙尘—辐射—海温反馈可触发并放大 IOD 事件，为热带海气耦合变率提供了新的外强迫来源。
note.en: Identifies Middle East dust as an important external driver of the Indian Ocean Dipole: dust–radiation–SST feedbacks can trigger and amplify IOD events, adding a new external forcing to tropical coupled variability.

title.zh: Beaufort sea ice loss contributes to enhanced health exposure to fire weather over Southeast Asia
title.en: Beaufort sea ice loss contributes to enhanced health exposure to fire weather over Southeast Asia

authors.zh: **G Liu**, J Li, T Ying, Y Dong, Z Zhang, C Zhang, Q Li · 8, 60
authors.en: **G Liu**, J Li, T Ying, Y Dong, Z Zhang, C Zhang, Q Li · 8, 60

note.zh: 指出波弗特海海冰减少通过改变环流与湿度条件，加剧东南亚火险天气并放大人口健康暴露，把高纬海冰变化与低纬公共健康风险连接起来。
note.en: Shows that Beaufort Sea ice loss alters circulation and humidity, intensifying fire weather and population exposure to harmful smoke over Southeast Asia, linking high-latitude ice change to low-latitude public health risk.

title.zh: Estimation of Nighttime Aerosol Optical Depths Using the Ground-based Microwave Radiometer
title.en: Estimation of Nighttime Aerosol Optical Depths Using the Ground-based Microwave Radiometer

authors.zh: **G Liu**, J Li, S Yue, L Zhang, C Zhang · 18, 6705–6725
authors.en: **G Liu**, J Li, S Yue, L Zhang, C Zhang · 18, 6705–6725

note.zh: 提出用地基微波辐射计亮温反演夜间气溶胶光学厚度的方法，填补夜间 AOD 观测空白，为逐日气溶胶日变化与辐射效应研究提供新数据源。
note.en: Presents a nighttime AOD retrieval based on ground-based microwave radiometer brightness temperatures, filling the night-time AOD observation gap and enabling diurnal aerosol and radiative-forcing studies.

title.zh: North Atlantic and the Barents Sea Variability Contribute to the 2023 Extreme Fire Season in Canada
title.en: North Atlantic and the Barents Sea Variability Contribute to the 2023 Extreme Fire Season in Canada

note.zh: 定量分离北大西洋与巴伦支海海温、海冰变率的贡献，阐明气候变率如何把 2023 年加拿大史无前例的极端火季推向极值。
note.en: Separates the contributions of North Atlantic and Barents Sea SST/sea-ice variability, explaining how climate variability pushed the unprecedented 2023 Canadian fire season to extremes.

title.zh: Amundsen Sea Ice Loss Contributes to Australian Wildfires
title.en: Amundsen Sea Ice Loss Contributes to Australian Wildfires

note.zh: 发现南极阿蒙森海海冰损失通过遥相关调制澳大利亚的干湿与火险条件，为近年澳大利亚野火增多提供高纬驱动解释。
note.en: Links Amundsen Sea ice loss to Australian fire activity through teleconnections, offering a high-latitude driver for recent increases in Australian wildfires.

title.zh: Estimation of Nighttime Aerosol Optical Depths Using Atmospheric Infrared Sounder Longwave Radiances
title.en: Estimation of Nighttime Aerosol Optical Depths Using Atmospheric Infrared Sounder Longwave Radiances

authors.zh: **G Liu**, J Li, J Li, S Yue, R Zhou · 51, e2023GL108120
authors.en: **G Liu**, J Li, J Li, S Yue, R Zhou · 51, e2023GL108120

note.zh: 利用 AIRS 红外窗区辐亮度反演夜间气溶胶光学厚度，突破可见光反演依赖日照的限制，实现昼夜连续监测。
note.en: Retrieves nighttime AOD from AIRS infrared-window radiances, overcoming the daylight dependence of visible-band retrievals and enabling round-the-clock aerosol monitoring.

title.zh: The shift of decadal trend in Middle East dust activities attributed to North Tropical Atlantic variability
title.en: The shift of decadal trend in Middle East dust activities attributed to North Tropical Atlantic variability

note.zh: 揭示热带北大西洋海温变率是中东沙尘年代际趋势转折的关键驱动，解释了沙尘活动"先增后减"的年代际转折机制。
note.en: Identifies tropical North Atlantic SST variability as the key driver of the decadal turning point in Middle East dust activity, explaining the observed shift from increasing to decreasing dust trends.

mediaExtra.zh: 被福建省三模、广东省地理联考选作压轴题
mediaExtra.en: Selected as the culminating question in Fujian provincial and Guangdong provincial geography mock examinations

title.zh: Atlantic Multi-decadal Oscillation Modulates the Relationship Between ENSO and Fire Weather in Australia
title.en: Atlantic Multi-decadal Oscillation Modulates the Relationship Between ENSO and Fire Weather in Australia

note.zh: 指出大西洋多年代际振荡（AMO）调制 ENSO 与澳大利亚火险天气的关系，说明年代际背景会放大或削弱年际信号的现实影响。
note.en: Shows that the Atlantic Multidecadal Oscillation modulates the ENSO–Australian fire-weather relationship, so decadal background states can amplify or mute interannual signals.

title.zh: Increasing fire weather potential over Northeast China linked to declining Bering Sea ice
title.en: Increasing fire weather potential over Northeast China linked to declining Bering Sea ice

authors.zh: **G Liu**, J Li, T Ying, H Su, X Huang, Y Yu · 50, e2023GL105931
authors.en: **G Liu**, J Li, T Ying, H Su, X Huang, Y Yu · 50, e2023GL105931

note.zh: 发现白令海海冰减少与东北亚环流异常相联系，使中国东北野火潜势显著上升，为北方森林火险的北极驱动提供证据。
note.en: Connects declining Bering Sea ice with Northeast Asian circulation anomalies that raise fire-weather potential in Northeast China, evidencing an Arctic driver of northern forest fire risk.

title.en: Impact of sea surface temperature variability at different ocean basins on dust activities in the Gobi Desert and North China

note.en: Quantifies the relative contributions of basin-scale SST and sea ice to dust activity over the Gobi Desert and North China, identifying the dominant oceanic drivers of interannual dust variability.

title.zh: Pacific Walker Circulation strengthened by tropospheric aerosol forcing
title.en: Pacific Walker Circulation strengthened by tropospheric aerosol forcing

authors.zh: T Ying, S.-P Xie, R Allen, **G Liu**, J Li · 9, 176
authors.en: T Ying, S.-P Xie, R Allen, **G Liu**, J Li · 9, 176

note.zh: 指出对流层气溶胶强迫增强太平洋沃克环流，修正了"全球变暖必然削弱沃克环流"的简单认识，强调气溶胶的竞争性作用。
note.en: Shows that tropospheric aerosol forcing strengthens the Pacific Walker Circulation, complicating the simple expectation that warming necessarily weakens it.

title.zh: An AI-based algorithm for retrieving aerosol optical depth and single scattering albedo using All-Sky Imager observations
title.en: An AI-based algorithm for retrieving aerosol optical depth and single scattering albedo using All-Sky Imager observations

authors.zh: H Ni, J Li, L Chang, Y Dong, G Du, M Li, Q Li, **G Liu**, et al. · 19, 5871–5887
authors.en: H Ni, J Li, L Chang, Y Dong, G Du, M Li, Q Li, **G Liu**, et al. · 19, 5871–5887

note.zh: 基于全天空成像仪观测与人工智能算法，同步反演气溶胶光学厚度与单次散射反照率，提升站点尺度气溶胶吸收性的反演能力。
note.en: Uses all-sky imager observations with an AI algorithm to retrieve AOD and single-scattering albedo simultaneously, improving site-level characterisation of aerosol absorption.

title.zh: Machine learning-based estimation of clear-sky direct aerosol radiative forcing using multisensor satellite observations
title.en: Machine learning-based estimation of clear-sky direct aerosol radiative forcing using multisensor satellite observations

note.en: Combines multi-sensor satellite observations with machine learning to estimate clear-sky direct aerosol radiative forcing globally, reducing retrieval uncertainty.

title.zh: Fractional change of scattering and absorbing aerosols contributes to Northern Hemisphere Hadley circulation expansion
title.en: Fractional change of scattering and absorbing aerosols contributes to Northern Hemisphere Hadley circulation expansion

authors.zh: T Ying, J Li, Q Fu, **G Liu**, L Zhang, Y Xia, Y Hu · 10, eadq9716
authors.en: T Ying, J Li, Q Fu, **G Liu**, L Zhang, Y Xia, Y Hu · 10, eadq9716

note.zh: 提出散射性与吸收性气溶胶比例变化是北半球哈德莱环流扩张的新机制，为理解季风与干旱带迁移提供线索。
note.en: Proposes that fractional changes in scattering versus absorbing aerosols drive Northern Hemisphere Hadley circulation expansion, with implications for monsoon and dry-zone shifts.

authors.en: Z Jiang, J Li, **G Liu**, C Zhang · 51, e2024GL110108

note.en: Reveals that the Indian Ocean Dipole modulates planetary boundary layer ozone over China through circulation and photochemistry, linking ocean variability to air quality.

note.en: Attributes part of the recent monsoon rainfall decline over the Gangetic Plain to increased aerosol scattering, with implications for South Asian water resources.

title.en: Changes of Water Vapor Budget over East Asia in Response to 4xCO2 Concentration Forcing

authors.en: Z Shen, T Xu, **G Liu**, X Sun, X.-Q Yang · 15, 313

note.en: Quantifies changes in the East Asian water-vapour budget (evaporation, transport and convergence) under 4×CO2 forcing.
